checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: Coverage evidence cites line ranges that do not exist: packages/client/src/views/shared/useLocationMenuPlacement.ts has 115 lines, yet Tasks 3.1 cites ':101-163', FR1 ':118-145', FR2 ':142-144', FR3 ':149-150', UX1 ':87-89' and ':130-135'. The actual code is: capture scroll/resize listeners at 100-101, maxHeight/overflowY at 93-95, 'top-full mt-1'/'bottom-full mb-1' at 38-40, fixed bottom with LOCATION_MENU_OFFSET_PX at 79-87. Correct every such citation.

R2's severity and the Verdict are inconsistent with the acceptance criteria. The review marks task 3.4 '❌' (ticked in tasks.md, but the task says the scenario 'keeps London' and grid_view_layers_e2e.feature:41 seeds a duplicate 'Tokyo', which parseStoredLocations.ts:78 'if (knownIds.has(id)) continue;' drops, leaving 11 locations against the grid-view delta's 'with 12 locations'). The criteria reserve CRITICAL for 'a ticked-but-undone task', yet R2 is a WARNING and the Verdict says 'Ready. No finding blocks: there is no CRITICAL finding'. Either raise R2 to CRITICAL and make the Verdict not-ready, or justify why 3.4 counts as done and mark it ✅.
